prior_year_events.event_name: RITC of Syndicate 1969 (2017 & prior) and Syndicate 3330 (2018)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Unfavourable claims movements related to RITC portfolios (Syndicate 1969 2017 & prior and Syndicate 3330 2018) caused strengthening of prior year reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were $133.432m at 1 January 2024. During 2024 the syndicate recorded a gross strengthening in prior year reserves of $22.288m (16.7% of opening reserves), driven by adverse claims development primarily associated with two RITC transactions (Syndicate 1969 2017 & prior and Syndicate 3330 2018). The movement reduced reinsurers' recoverable by $10.580m resulting in a net impact of $11.708m. The development predominantly affects casualty-related liability lines (including marine & energy liability exposures) and reflects unfavourable claim movements on inherited RITC portfolios.
raw_causal_phrases: predominantly due to unfavourable claims development during the year.

The calendar year result reflects an underwriting loss from unfavourable claims movements in respect of two RITC transactions written in 2021: a RITC for the liabilities relating to the 2017 and prior YoAs of Syndicate 1969 and a RITC of the 2018 YoA of Syndicate 3330.
No new business was written during 2024 and therefore the net claims incurred of $11,708,000 (2023: $6,360,000) represents a deterioration in the claims reserves established at the prior year end.
The majority of the reserves held by Syndicate 1994 (>90%) relate to the transfer of reserves from Syndicate 1969's 2017 & prior YoAs.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts in the report are presented in $'000 and have been converted to millions (native currency USD) for this JSON. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' (gross) at 1 Jan 2024. Prior year development (gross) taken from Technical provisions note 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross $22,288k). Claims development triangle is impacted by RITC transactions which materially distort inherited reserve profiles; this may affect allocation of movements by line. Premium mix total is very small ($11k) resulting in large percentage magnitudes for individual lines; some direct classes show negative written premium values in the statutory segmental table.
